notes.title: MOURNIGHT v0.1.0 Update – Major Improvements!
notes.content:
A new update has arrived, bringing big improvements and fixes to [i]MOURNIGHT[/i]!

[list]
[*][b]New Main Menu[/b] – Completely redesigned for a better experience.

[*][b]Crash Fixes[/b] – The game no longer crashes when entering.

[*][b]Lobby System[/b] – Create lobbies, invite friends easily, and join directly with invites. You can now set a password for your lobby.

[*][b]Key & Door Improvements[/b] – Doors are now numbered, and keys match them for easier navigation.

[*][b]New Language Support[/b] – Added Turkish, Russian, and Simplified Chinese!
[/list]
More updates coming soon—stay tuned and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Update v0.0.2 - Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
Dear players,
The [b]v0.0.2[/b] update is now live! We've fixed some bugs and made general improvements to the game. Here are the changes in this update:

[list]
[*] [b]The item description screen no longer causes the game to freeze.[/b]
Previously, when an item was picked up, the description screen would not close, causing the game to freeze. This screen has been temporarily removed, resolving the issue.

[*] [b]Several map-related bugs have been fixed.[/b]
We've addressed a few issues with the map.

[*] [b]A few minor bugs have been fixed.[/b]
Various small fixes have been made to improve the overall stability of the game.
[/list]
If you've encountered these issues in previous versions, give it another try! Don't forget to share your feedback and suggestions with us.

Thank you and enjoy the game!
